import ctypes,glob,os,subprocess
lib=ctypes.CDLL('libzstd.so.1')
class InBuf(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_=[('src',ctypes.c_void_p),('size',ctypes.c_size_t),('pos',ctypes.c_size_t)]
class OutBuf(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_=[('dst',ctypes.c_void_p),('size',ctypes.c_size_t),('pos',ctypes.c_size_t)]
lib.ZSTD_createDStream.restype=ctypes.c_void_p
lib.ZSTD_initDStream.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]; lib.ZSTD_initDStream.restype=ctypes.c_size_t
lib.ZSTD_decompressStream.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.POINTER(OutBuf),ctypes.POINTER(InBuf)]; lib.ZSTD_decompressStream.restype=ctypes.c_size_t
lib.ZSTD_freeDStream.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]
def decomp(data):
    ds=lib.ZSTD_createDStream(); lib.ZSTD_initDStream(ds)
    sbuf=ctypes.create_string_buffer(data)
    ib=InBuf(ctypes.cast(sbuf,ctypes.c_void_p),len(data),0)
    chunks=[]
    while True:
        obuf=ctypes.create_string_buffer(1<<20)
        ob=OutBuf(ctypes.cast(obuf,ctypes.c_void_p),len(obuf),0)
        r=lib.ZSTD_decompressStream(ds,ctypes.byref(ob),ctypes.byref(ib))
        if r>2**63: raise SystemExit('err')
        chunks.append(obuf.raw[:ob.pos])
        if ib.pos==ib.size and r==0: break
        if ib.pos==ib.size and r!=0: raise SystemExit('need more input')
    lib.ZSTD_freeDStream(ds)
    return b''.join(chunks)
for deb in glob.glob('*.deb'):
    tmp=deb+'.d'; os.makedirs(tmp,exist_ok=True)
    subprocess.run(['ar','x',os.path.abspath(deb)],cwd=tmp,check=True)
    out=decomp(open(os.path.join(tmp,'data.tar.zst'),'rb').read())
    open(os.path.join(tmp,'data.tar'),'wb').write(out)
    subprocess.run(['tar','xf','data.tar'],cwd=tmp,check=True)
    print('extracted',deb,len(out))
